description: This Java class represents a service layer for managing Event entities, including CRUD operations, validation, and searching for overlapping events within a calendar or scheduling application.

classes.name: EventService
classes.description: Service layer class for Event management providing validation and CRUD operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and saves a new Event after validating its fields.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Event objects from the repository.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches an Event by its unique id, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Event with new data, after validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an Event by its id, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: findByRange
methods.description: Finds Events overlapping a specific time range.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Private method to ensure Event has valid start/end times and title.
